# Creative Direct Marketing Group (CDMG)

> Creative Direct Marketing Group (CDMG) is a full-service direct response advertising and digital marketing agency founded in 1985 and based in Nashville, Tennessee. CDMG has won more than 100 marketing awards for accountable, profitable, breakthrough campaigns across direct mail, digital, and media. CDMG helps regulated and high-consideration brands acquire customers through tested, measurable, multichannel direct response.

CDMG combines direct mail, digital marketing, and media buying into one accountable system built on testing and measurement. The company is known for its proprietary 5 Dimensional Marketing methodology and its in-house data engine, InfoMat, established in 1978.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://cdmginc.com/): Overview of CDMG, its results, clients, and awards.
- [5 Dimensional Marketing](https://cdmginc.com/5-dimensional-marketing/): CDMG's proprietary methodology (Load & Aim, Direct Mail Magic, Digital Marketing, Media Revived, and Test, Analyze, Tune).
- [Why You](https://cdmginc.com/why-you/): The industries and verticals CDMG serves, including consumer health, financial products, nutrition, insurance, energy, media, and emerging brands.
- [Our Story](https://cdmginc.com/our-story/): CDMG history since 1985, the leadership team, and the InfoMat data engine established in 1978.
- [Contact](https://cdmginc.com/contact/): Get a free consultation. Call 615.933.4647 or email info@cdmginc.com.

## Services

- [Compliant Product Marketing](https://cdmginc.com/compliant-product-marketing/): Direct response campaigns for regulated categories that perform and stay within FDA, FTC, and SEC rules.
- [Direct Mail Marketing](https://cdmginc.com/direct-mail-marketing/): 40+ years of tested direct mail; more than one billion pieces mailed; inventor of the magalog format (1986).
- [Supplement Marketing](https://cdmginc.com/supplement-marketing/): Compliant customer acquisition and retention for supplement and nutraceutical brands.
- [Financial Marketing](https://cdmginc.com/financial-marketing/): Subscriber and investor acquisition for financial publishers, newsletters, and financial products.
- [Regulation A Marketing](https://cdmginc.com/regulation-a-marketing/): Investor acquisition campaigns for Regulation A+ and exempt offerings.

## DMU Blog

The Direct Marketing Update (DMU) Blog publishes strategy, testing, compliance, and digital marketing insights, with more than 2,000 articles.

- [DMU Blog](https://cdmginc.com/dmu-blog/): The full library of direct response and digital marketing articles.
- [Why Direct Mail Still Wins in a Digital World](https://cdmginc.com/dmu-blog/why-direct-mail-still-wins/): Why the mailbox remains one of the most accountable, profitable marketing channels, and how to pair it with digital.
